subject: Intro: Redwood x CloudSI co-sell / Marketplace demo — scheduling

Subject: Intro: Redwood x CloudSI co-sell / Marketplace demo

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for taking a look at the idea of a joint marketplace listing and co-sell motion with CloudSI. Linda (CloudSI) and I chatted and we think a short joint demo (30–40 min) showing Redwood on the major clouds and how CloudSI would position implementation makes sense as a next step.

Quick ask: can we find 30 minutes next week for a joint demo with product + solutions engineering from both sides? Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed 2026-03-11, 10:00–10:40
- Thu 2026-03-12, 14:00–14:40
- Fri 2026-03-13, 09:00–09:40

We’ll invite AWS Marketplace and include the marketplace ops alias for listing logistics. If you have a preferred agenda I can draft and circulate.

Thanks — Samir

Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace
Amazon Web Services

Hi Samir —

Thanks — those slots mostly work. I can do Wed 3/11 at 10am PST and Thu 3/12 at 2pm PST; Camila (our Solutions Eng lead) is also looping in to confirm SE availability and make sure we have the right environment demos (GCP + Azure + AWS).

Proposed agenda (30–40 min):
1) Quick intros & GTM asks (5 min)
2) Short product demo showing multi-cloud deployment on AWS + Azure + GCP (15–20 min)
3) CloudSI implementation approach and timelines (5–8 min)
4) Marketplace/next steps (5 min)

Camila — can you confirm if 3/11 10am PST or 3/12 2pm PST works for you? Also I attached the deck we typically use for marketplace discussions.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Thanks — Linda
